header.title: Trusted by Thousands
header.description: Real feedback from Minecraft communities across India — blazing performance, instant setup, and support that actually replies.

reviews.name: Arjun Sharma
reviews.text: Bhai, TPS is solid even with 40+ players on modded. Setup took under a minute and ping from Mumbai is crazy low.

reviews.name: Priya Patel
reviews.text: Switched from another host last month. Zero lag during events and backups saved our SMP twice already. Worth every rupee.

reviews.name: Rahul Verma
reviews.text: Panel is clean, file manager is fast, and support answered on Discord within minutes. Best hosting I've used in India.

reviews.name: Ananya Iyer
reviews.text: Running a creative server for our college club — no crashes, smooth chunk loading, and pricing is honestly unbeatable.

reviews.name: Vikram Singh
reviews.text: Bedrock and Java both run smooth on the Singapore node for our mixed community. DDoS protection actually works.

reviews.name: Kavya Nair
reviews.text: Plugin installer is a lifesaver. Deployed LuckPerms and Essentials in clicks. Uptime has been 99.9% for us.

reviews.name: Rohan Mehta
reviews.text: We host weekend minigame events — 60 players, no rubber-banding. Caspian Host is our permanent home now.

reviews.name: Isha Gupta
reviews.text: Skyblock economy server runs buttery smooth. NVMe storage shows — world saves are instant after restarts.

reviews.name: Aditya Joshi
reviews.text: Heavy modpack on Ryzen tier — no joke, best performance per rupee. Migration from old host was painless.

reviews.name: Sneha Reddy
reviews.text: Lifesteal SMP with 35 players online peak. Support helped tune JVM flags. Five stars, no question.

reviews.name: Karan Malhotra
reviews.text: Faction wars every Sunday — zero downtime during raids. Panel console is responsive and easy for our mods.

reviews.name: Divya Krishnan
reviews.text: Bedrock realm for family & friends in Tamil Nadu. Low ping, simple billing in INR. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Amit Desai
reviews.text: As a server owner for 3 years, this is the most stable node I've rented. Benchmarks match what they advertise.

reviews.name: Pooja Bansal
reviews.text: WorldEdit schematics upload fast, subusers work perfectly for our build team. Premium feel at budget price.

reviews.name: Harsh Yadav
reviews.text: Hardcore world with 20 slots — not a single unexpected restart in two months. Trustworthy Indian hosting.

reviews.name: Neha Kapoor
reviews.text: Our Discord community of 2k members loves the server stability. Onboarding new players is super easy.

reviews.name: Suresh Iyer
reviews.text: Vanilla SMP for old school friends — feels like playing on local LAN. Support team understands Minecraft properly.

reviews.name: Meera Shah
reviews.text: Hosted a 48-hour charity stream event — server held up flawlessly. Will upgrade RAM next month for sure.

reviews.name: Varun Nambiar
reviews.text: OneBlock progression server — chunk gen is fast, no lag spikes. Best decision for our Malayali player base.

reviews.name: Ritika Chopra
reviews.text: Running a small network of 3 servers under one account. Billing is clear, panel is pro-level. 5/5 from Kolkata.
